jobs.title: Customer Experience Research Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Not everyone can claim to feed the world, but it is part of our every day. Behind everything we do for our farmers, there is one AGCO team making it happen. We are proud to put our curiosity to work, building a better and more sustainable world. Join our extraordinary team today!

AGCO is hiring a  Customer Experience (CX) Measurement & Inner Loop Program Manager  to accelerate the automation and digitalization of our global CX survey ecosystem, manage Qualtrics survey operations, and lead the development and regional roll-out of NPS Inner Loop program.

Your Impact

- Qualtrics Platform Governance: Act as the global Qualtrics owner, managing daily operations, platform governance, data quality, reporting, user support, vendor coordination, and continuous optimization of survey processes.

- Oversee end‑to‑end automation of AGCO’s CX survey ecosystem, including definition of business requirements, survey triggering logic, business rules, data flows, and validation of development with Digital Product teams.

- Inner Loop Program Management: Manage the full lifecycle of the CX Inner Loop program — scope, requirements, integrations, training, launch, KPIs, and ongoing improvements — ensuring strong business and technical alignment.

- Regional Rollout & Change Management: Drive global rollout of the Survey automation and Inner Loop tools; ensure technical readiness, process consistency, stakeholder alignment, and deliver training for internal and dealer users.

- Cross‑Functional Leadership & IT Collaboration: Serve as the bridge between CX leadership, markets, IT/Data teams; manage execution, risks, dependencies, and testing across survey automation and Inner Loop programs.

Your Experience And Qualification

- Education & Experience: University degree with 7+ years in market research, customer insights, survey programming.

- 3+ years of hands-on experience with Qualtrics or other survey management platform (Medalia, Forsta or alike) – surveys programming, workflows, integrations, admin; expert‑level certification strongly preferred.

- Technical Skills: strong project management and experience translating business requirements into IT deliverables. Comfortable operating as a  power user of survey technologies , with a practical understanding of integrations and data flows to guide development and validation.  No IT, coding, or data engineering background required ; the role partners closely with IT and Digital teams. Salesforce user experience preferred

- Tools & Collaboration: strong communication and stakeholder‑management skills, with the ability to work cross‑functionally across global teams.

- Working Style: Highly organized, detail‑oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple initiatives; entrepreneurial problem-solving mindset; fluent English.

Your Benefits:

-
Attractive, fair remuneration including participation in our bonus scheme and reimbursement of commuting expenses

-
Cafeteria system with additional elements you can pick from
Balance of work, family, and free time due to flexible working opportunity and the possibility of hybrid work including home office monetary allowance

-
Private health insurance, dental services, and compensation for the purchase of computer monitor glasses

-
Employee Assistance Program including professional counselling, webinars, sports challenges, and newsletters

-
Development opportunities including monthly trainings held by the local training team and teacher guided language classes

Your Workplace:

AGCO Shared Service Center (SSC) is located at Office Garden in the 11th district, in one of the most dynamically developing areas of Budapest providing global support to all AGCO global factories and sites in Finance, HR, IT, Purchasing, Customer Experience and Engineering functions. The office is easily accessible by car and public transport. Restaurants, cafés, and shopping centers are also located around the office.

We value inclusion and recognize the innovation a diverse workforce delivers to our farmers. Through our recruitment efforts, we are committed to building a team that includes a variety of experiences, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives.

Join our extraordinary team today and apply now!

jobs.title: Program Manager, Culture & Employee Experience, PTx
jobs.description:
Not everyone can claim to feed the world, but it is part of our every day. Behind everything we do for our farmers, there is one AGCO team making it happen. We are proud to put our curiosity to work, building a better and more sustainable world. Join our extraordinary team today!

The Program Manager, Employee Experience & Culture Transformation - PTx leads the design and delivery of employee experience and culture transformation programs that support the integration of PTx entities and a unified culture aligned with AGCO. The role applies specialized expertise in employee experience, culture, change and program management to interpret business challenges, recommend best practices and translate strategic objectives into executable global programs. Working independently with guidance in the most complex situations, the role leads cross-functional project teams and stakeholder networks, establishes program measures, manages delivery risks, and influences leaders and partners to adopt solutions that improve engagement, culture, and employee experience outcomes.

Your Impact

Strategic Culture Integration

-
Align with the Director, EX & Culture and the PTx GHRBP to advance priorities emerging from the 2026 North Star Summit.

-
Align PTx initiatives with AGCO’s global culture strategy, VOICES insights, and enterprise transformation priorities.

-
Reinforce AGCO’s core cultural beliefs (e.g., Farmer First, Speak Up!, Team Up!) while enabling flexibility within PTx to sustain local identity.

-
Support the positioning of PTx as a strategic growth engine within AGCO, strengthening alignment between PTx and enterprise culture.

Employee Engagement & Experience

-
Design and deliver PTx-wide engagement initiatives (e.g., town halls, connection events) to promote transparency, alignment, and employee connection.

-
Own or coordinate the operating model for recurring PTx employee and leader forums, including annual cadence, agenda design, presenter readiness, content integration, production coordination, Q&A management, post-event materials, and continuous improvement.

-
Evaluate and optimize existing engagement activities, leveraging global tools and platforms to increase participation, belonging, and cultural cohesion.

-
Provide an audit of what tools and platforms can be accessed and where PTx IT support going forward is required.

-
Ensure key employee moments (e.g., onboarding, listening, recognition) are intentionally designed and aligned to both PTx and AGCO identity and processes.

Internal Communications

-
Partner with Corporate Communications to develop and implement a sustainable communication strategy, including newsletters and targeted campaigns.

-
Utilize analytics to assess effectiveness of communication channels and continuously improve messaging strategies.

-
Ensure consistent, clear, and accessible communication that reinforces business priorities and transformation efforts in alignment with stated Organizational Change Management processes and controls.

-
Establish and maintain governance for PTx employee communication channels, including ownership, audience segmentation, distribution lists, publishing routes, access requirements, and approval responsibilities.

-
Lead the end-to-end development and coordination of PTx executive and leadership communications, including town halls, leader talking points, FAQs, video scripts, Q&A preparation, communication toolkits, and post-event follow-up.

-
Translate complex business, organizational, and transformation topics into clear, audience-appropriate messages for employees and people leaders.

-
Coordinate review and approval workflows with PTx leadership, HR, Corporate Communications, and other subject-matter owners.

-
Shape messaging to strengthen understanding of PTx’s role both within and outside of AGCO, their unique selling point / value proposition to help reinforce a unified organizational narrative

People Managers Enablement

-
Design and coordinate PTx people-manager communication and engagement forums that equip leaders to reinforce culture, explain organizational changes, and respond consistently to employee questions.

-
Develop scalable leader toolkits, key messages, FAQs, discussion guides, and other resources that support effective team-level communication.

-
Partner with HR and business leadership to identify recurring manager capability needs and connect leaders with appropriate enterprise resources.

Site Engagement & Enablement

-
Continue building the Site Leader Engagement Network by leveraging VOICES data to identify location-specific engagement opportunities, supporting change management efforts and the transition toward the AGCO Culture Champion network.

-
Create scalable, self-service tools and resources to enable site-level engagement activities, events, and initiatives.

-
Act as a central coordination point to ensure alignment while supporting local customization.

Change Management & Organizational Insight

-
Partner with the global Organizational Change Management (OCM) team to support PTx-related change initiatives, ensuring alignment and avoiding duplication.

-
Support Organizational Change Management with AI and Cultural Integration efforts as directed by the Director of Employee Experience and Culture and other stakeholders

-
Provide insights and recommendations to inform decision-making related to organizational effectiveness and cultural integration.

PTx Organizational Identity

-
Protect and strengthen the distinct PTx identity while aligning with AGCO’s employer brand (“Where Extraordinary Grows”).

-
Support the evolution from a “PTx vs. AGCO” mindset to a unified narrative positioning PTx as integral to AGCO’s success in technology and innovation.

-
Enable storytelling, shared experiences, and leadership role modeling to reinforce desired cultural outcomes.

Global Employee Experience & Culture Program Delivery

-
Aligning with the Director, Global Employee Experience & Culture to plan, execute, and monitor global EX & Culture programs aligned to AGCO’s strategic priorities.

-
Develop and manage comprehensive project plans, timelines, and deliverables to ensure timely and high-quality program execution.

-
Establish program success criteria, define performance metrics, and measure program impact to drive continuous improvement.

-
Coordinate and align cross-functional stakeholders, including HR, business leaders, vendors, and external partners, to ensure successful program delivery.

-
Manage program governance, including meeting facilitation, action tracking, and status reporting to senior leadership.

-
Oversee external partners and Statements of Work (SOWs), ensuring alignment with budget and program objectives.

-
Apply subject matter expertise and project management discipline to deliver scalable, sustainable employee experience solutions globally.

-
Support change management initiatives in alignment with global organizational change strategies.

-
Analyze complex organizational challenges and deliver practical, insight-driven solutions to enhance employee experience and culture.

Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

-
Build strong partnerships with Global EX & Culture Program Managers, a network of ~50 Culture Champions, and key internal and external stakeholders.

-
Provide coordination and oversight of all parties involved in program execution to ensure alignment, accountability, and delivery against commitments.

-
Foster collaboration across regions and functions to balance global consistency with local relevance.

Your Experience and Qualifications

-
Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Organizational Development, Communications, or related field

-
8 years of experience in employee experience, culture, HR programs, or organizational initiatives

-
Demonstrated experience managing projects or programs end-to-end, including planning, execution, and tracking outcomes

-
Experience working in a matrixed, global, or cross-functional environment with multiple stakeholders

-
Working knowledge of employee engagement, culture, and change management principles

-
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with ability to manage competing priorities

-
Effective communication and presentation skills with experience delivering updates to stakeholders

-
Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, with ability to leverage data to support decision-making

Your Benefits

-
Health care and wellness plans

-
Dental and vision plans

-
401(k) Savings Plan with company match

-
Employee Stock Purchase Plan offering eligible employees the ability to purchase AGCO stock at a discounted price

-
Paid holidays and paid time off

-
Health savings and flexible spending accounts

-
Reimbursement for continuing education

-
Life insurance and other supplemental insurance plans

Your Compensation

This position offers a base salary range of $95,000 to $120,000, with final compensation determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is also eligible for a target annual bonus eligibility of 15% of base salary, as part of AGCO’s total rewards program.

Your Workplace

This role follows AGCO’s on-site work model, with employees primarily working from an AGCO USA location (Tremont_IL OR Batavia_IL) for a 4 days per week to support collaboration and teamwork.

We value inclusion and recognize the innovation a diverse workforce delivers to our farmers. Through our recruitment efforts, we are committed to building a team that includes a variety of experiences, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives.

Join our extraordinary team today and apply now!

AGCO is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.

Recruiter Scam Alert: AGCO has observed an increase in individuals impersonating AGCO recruiters. All legitimate AGCO recruiting communications are conducted only through official AGCO recruiters or AGCO authorized recruitment partners using official company email accounts (@agcocorp.com or .external@agcocorp.com). AGCO recruiters and partners will never use personal email addresses (such as Gmail, Yahoo, or similar). Any communication claiming to represent AGCO outside of these channels should be treated as fraudulent. All legitimate AGCO job opportunities are posted on our official career site at careers.agcocorp.com. Candidates are encouraged to apply directly through the site and maintain an active candidate profile.

jobs.title: Global Program Manager MES
jobs.description:
AGCO is seeking a Global MES Product Manager to help define, guide, and execute the global vision for our Manufacturing Execution Systems product line. In this role, you will partner with a focused team to shape the product strategy, translate manufacturing needs into actionable roadmap priorities, and ensure AGCO’s MES solutions deliver meaningful value to manufacturing operations.

The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on manufacturing experience, a strong understanding of how MES solutions are used on the shop floor, and the ability to connect operational challenges with practical product solutions. You will assess customer needs, evaluate competitive offerings, and use market insight to guide product recommendations, development, investment priorities, cost considerations, and long-term growth strategy.

This role requires frequent collaboration with internal customers, our IT organization, manufacturing teams, Engineering and other product stakeholders across global regions. You will be expected to communicate clearly, build trusted relationships, facilitate productive discussions, and use sound judgment to balance customer feedback, business priorities, and operational realities.

As the subject matter expert and super-user for AGCO’s MES products, you will help establish product quality expectations, support roadmap alignment, and serve as a key voice in defining how our MES portfolio evolves to meet current and future manufacturing needs.

Not everyone can claim to feed the world, but it is part of our every day. Behind everything we do for our farmers, there is one AGCO team making it happen. We are proud to put our curiosity to work, building a better and more sustainable world. Join our extraordinary team today!

Your Impact

-
Hands-on manufacturing experience. Turn fragmentation into a coherent streamlined architecture

-
You bring order to a complex multi system landscape

-
Your focus on UI UX means operators on the shop floor get tools that are usable not just functional improving efficiency and reducing errors.

-
Your ownership of system performance keeps operations running reliably at scale

-
Through close partnership with the Data Lake team, you turn shop-floor data into a strategic asset. Laying the foundation for better decisions, analytics and future AI / Automation initiatives across the company.

Your Experience and qualifications

-
Minimum of 10 years of MES exposure or related manufacturing systems experience.  Key Problem-Solving Responsibilities

-
Minimum 4-5 years of Manufacturing Engineering Experience.

-
Align customer feedback with operational realities, business priorities, and product strategy.

-
Advocate for and defend product priorities with other Product Owners within the Agile Process.

-
Define and uphold product quality guardrails, serving as a key quality gate for customer-facing MES capabilities.

Your Benefits

-
Health care and wellness plans

-
Dental and vision plans

-
Flexible and virtual work options (where available)

-
401(k) Savings Plan with company match

-
Paid holidays and paid time off

-
Health savings and flexible spending accounts

-
Reimbursement for continuing education

-
Life insurance and other supplemental insurance plan

-
Employee Stock Purchase Plan offering eligible employees the ability to purchase AGCO stock at a discounted price

Your Workplace

This role follows AGCO’s on‑site work model, with employees primarily working from Duluth, USA a minimum of 4 days per week to support collaboration and teamwork.

We value inclusion and recognize the innovation a diverse workforce delivers to our farmers. Through our recruitment efforts, we are committed to building a team that includes a variety of experiences, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives.

Join us as we bring agriculture into the future and apply now!
